title: Recording editor
welcomeSelect: Select a meeting from the list.
welcomeEdit: Choose which intervals to keep and where to replace audio with a beep. Saving creates backups and updates events.xml and the referenced raw audio.
manualRebuild: After saving to raw, use the separate Rebuild recording action to apply the edits to playback.
reviewCounts: Keep: {record, plural, one {# interval} other {# intervals}} / Beep: {beep, plural, one {# interval} other {# intervals}}
reviewDetails: Preserve the first-save XML and raw audio/video, back up events.xml, and write new recording start/stop events. Regenerate all current beep intervals from the original microphone and screen-sharing audio, create separate media files, and update the XML references.
needRange: Choose at least one interval to keep. BigBlueButton cannot safely handle an empty recording, so saving is disabled.
noRebuild: Saving to raw does not rebuild the recording. Use Rebuild recording after saving.
externalAudio: External video audio is not included in the raw audio and cannot be replaced with a beep.
audioError: Cannot load the preview audio. Reload the meeting.
dragHint: Drag the waveform to select an interval. Drag its edges to adjust it.
invalidTime: Enter times within the meeting, with start < end
waveform: Original audio waveform (beeps shown as intervals)
wavePending: The waveform appears after preview generation
draftSaved: Draft saved. Raw data has not been changed.
rawSaved: Saved. XML backup: {backup}. Use Rebuild recording to apply the changes to playback.
recentHint: Past 14 days · missing raw data is flagged
selectionHidden: The selected meeting is hidden by the filter. Its editor remains open.
saveBeforeSwitch: Save a draft or save to raw before switching meetings.
videoError: The browser cannot play this video ({file}).
invalidShapes: Cannot display {count, plural, one {# shape} other {# shapes}}. Original events will be preserved when saving.
shapeError: Cannot display the drawings. Original events will be preserved when saving.
reviewAudioWarning: This save changes raw audio as well as XML. All microphone audio and screen-sharing audio overlapping the selected intervals will be redacted. New files are added to raw and events.xml is updated to reference them. Original files and backups are retained. Webcam video and external video service audio are not processed.
reviewAudioRestore: Removing all beep intervals restores the original audio references in XML. Previously generated redacted files are retained.
saveBeforeRebuild: Save changes to raw before rebuilding. Saving a draft does not apply the changes.
rebuildSetup: Rebuild is unavailable. The server rebuild helper is missing or is not executable by the service. This is separate from raw saving and resetting.
rebuildReviewDetails: Ask BigBlueButton to rebuild this meeting using the saved raw events.xml and media. Unsaved edits and drafts are not included.
rebuildWarning: Existing published and unpublished playback files for all installed recording formats will be removed and regenerated. They will be unavailable until processing completes. Original raw files and editor backups are retained.
rebuildPublishedWarning: Processing runs through the normal BigBlueButton queue. Unpublished status is not guaranteed to be preserved. Check publication status afterwards and unpublish again if needed.
rebuildRequested: Recording rebuild requested. It is not complete yet. Waiting for BigBlueButton to finish processing.
rebuildCompleted: Recording rebuild completed. Reload playback and check the audio and publication status.
rebuildFailed: Recording rebuild failed. Check the BigBlueButton and editor logs. Existing playback files may have been removed.
resetUnavailable: A first-save backup is required. Legacy saves also need the original pre-save XML backup.
resetReviewDetails: Restore events.xml and raw audio/video from before the first save in this editor. Archive the current XML, saved settings, draft and generated beep media. Later edits will still start from the same original sources.
resetWarning: Saved edits, unsaved changes, on-screen Undo history and the active draft will leave the editing screen. Original means immediately before the first save in this editor. Legacy recordings require the original unchanged media to remain available.
resetPublished: Published and unpublished playback recordings stay as they are until a separate rebuild. If the original XML has no recording intervals, specify and save intervals to raw before rebuilding.
resetCompleted: Original state restored to raw. No additional raw save is needed. Previous edits were archived. Rebuild to apply this state to playback.
rawAlreadySaved: Current edits are already saved to raw. Save to raw is unnecessary until you make changes. Use Rebuild recording to apply raw data to playback.
resetNeedsRebuild: Original state is restored to raw. Its application to playback has not been confirmed. Rebuild recording to apply it; no additional raw save is needed.
rawNeedsRebuild: Raw changes need to be applied to playback. Rebuild recording to apply them.
rawReflected: A rebuild for the current raw data has completed.
saveCandidateRanges: The raw XML has no valid recording intervals. On-screen intervals are editing candidates. Check the intervals and save to raw before rebuilding.
rebuildBlockedProcessing: Another rebuild cannot be requested while recording processing is in progress. Wait for it to finish.
rebuildInstallHint: In the editor installation directory on the BBB server (default: /opt/bbb-recording-editor), run the command below and reload the browser. It installs the helper and permissions; it does not rebuild recordings.
resetUnmarkedCompleted: Original state restored to raw, but its XML has no valid recording intervals. Current intervals are editing candidates. To rebuild, save the intervals you want to keep to raw, adding them to the XML.
